summary: Tested the new /cliente Indique e Ganhe page (frontend) and the backing /api/customer/* endpoints. Backend pytest suite is 10/10 green. Cliente frontend flows (login mask, invalid CPF error, valid CPF login -> Maria dashboard, invite card with URL/Copy/WhatsApp/QR, tabs, PIX save, logout clearing localStorage) all work as specified. The only failure is a regression on the existing /r/<code> Referral Landing page (NOT caused by the cliente work) — ReferralLandingPage.js calls api.publicReferralInfo which does not exist in /app/frontend/src/api.js, so the public landing page crashes with a JS error.

integration_issues.issue: ReferralLandingPage component crashes: 'api.publicReferralInfo is not a function' (also api.publicReferralSubmit). The api.js module does not export these methods. The referral-landing-shell never mounts. This breaks the link that the /cliente Invite Card shares to friends, so end-to-end the share flow is broken even though /cliente itself works.

action_items: Implement (or re-add) api.publicReferralInfo(code) and api.publicReferralSubmit(code, form) in /app/frontend/src/api.js. These should call the existing backend public referral endpoints (likely GET /api/referrals/landing/{code} and POST /api/referrals/submit/{code}, see /app/backend/routes/referrals.py). Without them, every invite link generated by /cliente lands on a blank/crashed page.
Add an error boundary around ReferralLandingPage so a missing api method does not silently white-screen end users.
critical_code_review_comments: ClienteIndicaApp.js is 863 lines and contains the entire login + dashboard + invite + leaderboard + money tab — consider splitting per-tab components into separate files (it exceeds the 700-line soft limit).
In ClienteIndicaApp.js line 423-425 the style object has 'border' declared twice (background + border + border) — the first `border` is overwritten; harmless but a code-smell.
Token in localStorage ('ligo_indica_token') is opaque '<id>.<salt>' format; consider tightening expiry/rotation server-side since there is no password.
ReferralLandingPage import surface diverged from api.js — add a typecheck / lint rule to catch undefined exports.

The remaining blocker is the public landing /r/<code> JS error (missing api.publicReferralInfo / publicReferralSubmit in api.js). Once those are wired, retest by opening /r/H8NPCL7R (Maria's code) and confirming data-testid='referral-landing-shell' renders.
rca of the issue: ReferralLandingPage.js (lines 24, 33) calls api.publicReferralInfo(code) and api.publicReferralSubmit(code, form). A grep of /app/frontend/src/api.js shows neither function exists (the file does not contain any 'referral' reference). Result: TypeError at first render of /r/<code>, React unmounts the subtree, no error boundary is present, and the shell never appears. Repro: open ${REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/r/H8NPCL7R — page is blank, console shows '_api__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_1__.api.publicReferralInfo is not a function'. Fix: add the two helper functions to api.js pointing at the existing backend public-referral endpoints in /app/backend/routes/referrals.py.
